items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The record was with Art Taylor and Gene Ramey and they played beautifully for both of us

ctx.x: Those are two landmark records. What do you remember about the “Confucius” record with Tristano?

That was a very difficult situation for me. The record was with Art Taylor and Gene Ramey and they played beautifully for both of us but I don’t think I ever spent an intermission talking to them. I was generally upstairs trying reeds or doing something to try to relax, you know? I don’t know if I smoked to try to relax in those days. I kind of doubt it. I think that could’ve backfired on me, the way I was feeling. Then when I heard the record, finally, I was kind of disappointed in the way I sounded on the…
The funny thing is that . . . a lot of people consider that one of your landmark records.
